authority_invariant: No PENTA institutional service manufactures legal, economic, security, policy, governance, provider, or fiduciary authority. Consequential actions require an authority trace to CHLOM/DAIL and the accountable institutional owner, with PentaHybrid human gates where required.

systems.purpose: Capital-allocation, treasury, liquidity, portfolio, funding-envelope and capital-stack decision intelligence for CrownThrive.
systems.authority_boundary: Produces capital proposals, models and approval packets. It cannot transfer funds, open accounts, pledge assets, change beneficiaries, place trades, borrow, or otherwise bind capital without separately authorized provider rails and CHLOM/PentaHybrid approval.

systems.purpose: Impact measurement, logic models, outcomes, attribution, community benefit, cultural benefit, SROI-style analysis and program evaluation.
systems.authority_boundary: Measures and evaluates impact; it does not replace the CrownThrive Impact Institute, award funding, certify social claims, or authorize programs by itself.

systems.purpose: Cross-ecosystem metric semantics, data lineage, evidence aggregation, comparative analysis, forecasting and decision-grade analytical products.
systems.authority_boundary: Consumes and reconciles governed data from CrownLytics, CrownPulse and domain systems; it does not replace those products, redefine source metrics silently, or convert inference into authority.

systems.purpose: Legal-operations workflow for obligations, rights, contracts, licensing, legal holds, jurisdiction, review routing and counsel-ready evidence packets.
systems.authority_boundary: Performs legal operations and routing, not legal representation. It cannot provide or impersonate legal counsel, sign contracts, waive rights, settle claims, make legal admissions, or bind CrownThrive.

systems.purpose: Enterprise risk taxonomy, risk registers, exposure scoring, control mapping, tolerance, limits, escalation and residual-risk tracking.
systems.authority_boundary: Identifies, models and routes risk. It cannot accept consequential residual risk on behalf of an accountable owner or silently override policy thresholds.

systems.purpose: Independent evidence-led control testing, execution audit trails, findings, remediation tracking and re-test verification.
systems.authority_boundary: Audits executed state and control integrity. It does not self-certify releases, erase findings, approve its own remediation, or replace PentaAssure release-readiness certification.

systems.purpose: Policy drafting, lifecycle management, versioning, applicability, interpretation routing, exception tracking and obligations-to-controls mapping.
systems.authority_boundary: Models and administers policy lifecycle; it cannot enact, repeal, supersede or reinterpret binding policy without a traceable authorized source and required human/governance disposition.

systems.purpose: Ethics, integrity, conflict-of-interest, cultural-alignment, fairness and institutional-values review for consequential decisions.
systems.authority_boundary: Provides structured ethics review and escalation. It does not manufacture a veto, replace legal/compliance analysis, or create binding governance authority outside an adopted charter or policy.

systems.purpose: Security posture, threat/control assessment, incident-governance routing, protective-action proposals, verification and security evidence coordination.
systems.authority_boundary: May execute disruptive protective actions only under explicit pre-authorized incident capabilities or separately approved authority; it cannot create credentials, expand privilege, suppress evidence, or bypass provider/security controls.

systems.purpose: Scoped, provenance-aware, redacted operational memory and bounded context retrieval across approved CrownThrive systems.
systems.authority_boundary: Context is evidence and operational memory only. It never creates credentials, permissions, governance approval, provider-write authority, legal authority, money movement, or D3 effects.
